## MarketUtils.getSettlementFee() function

Computes the Midnight settlement fee from market cbp buckets and time to maturity.

This mirrors Midnight `settlementFee`<!-- -->: cbp buckets are scaled by [CBP](./midnight-sdk.cbp.md)<!-- -->, values are linearly interpolated between [SETTLEMENT\_FEE\_BREAKPOINTS](./midnight-sdk.settlement_fee_breakpoints.md)<!-- -->, and any time to maturity at or above 360 days uses the last bucket.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function getSettlementFee(params: {
        readonly settlementFeeCbps: SettlementFeeCbps;
        readonly timeToMaturity: BigIntish;
    }): bigint;
```

WAD-scaled settlement fee.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `timeToMaturity` is negative.

## Remarks

Parameter details:

- `params.settlementFeeCbps`<!-- -->: Seven settlement-fee centibip buckets from the market state.

- `params.timeToMaturity`<!-- -->: Seconds until market maturity.

## Example


```ts
import { MarketUtils } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

const fee = MarketUtils.getSettlementFee({
  settlementFeeCbps: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7],
  timeToMaturity: 12n * 60n * 60n,
});
console.log(fee);
```
